teams.name: Harbour Hawks

needs.text: We MUST land a genuine death bowler; we leaked 11.4 an over at the death last season.
Need a finisher who can strike at 160+ in overs 16-20.

teams.budget: Go hard on at most two marquee buys (up to 13 Cr each). Keep at least 6 Cr in reserve after the first marquee.
teams.style: Aggressive: pace-heavy attack on a bouncy home ground; power hitting over anchoring.
teams.risk: Will tolerate minor, cleared injuries. Avoid recurring back injuries in fast bowlers.
teams.overseas: Happy to use both overseas slots on bowlers.

needs.text: A frontline all-rounder is the missing piece; we will pay up to 15 Cr for the right one.
